source: reconstruction of Yang, Jia & Yan 2023, Table 6 (example (1))
matched: bi-degree (3,1) (polynomial); topology: one open straight tangential line along a ruling, half-way down the wall, spanning the full ruling length of both sheets; the sheets touch there with second-order contact and cross (blue in front above the line, orange below, as drawn); appearance fitted to the Surfaces panel (camera and IoU in 'fit'): blue ruled S-step strip seen nearly along its flat parts, shorter orange S whose tails turn earlier and stick out of the blue band
guessed: the paper's control nets are not published: the profile is a cubic graph in a frame aligned with the wall (fitted), the contact order (2, the lowest odd order that matches the drawn crossing) and the reflection that sets the drawn depth order are inferred from the picture
paper_other_methods: paper: the open-source kernel and the commercial kernel returned nothing, the spline library scattered points
truth_method: closed form: both sheets are graphs h(s) over the same (s, w) plane with h_o - h_b = (a3o - a3) s^3, so the intersection is exactly the ruling s = 0
